West London · Fully Mobile · Eco-Friendly

Eco-Friendly Mobile Car Valeting & Detailing for West London Drivers

Ecoverde Valeting brings premium car care to your door: biodegradable products, an electric van, steam cleaning and a meticulous showroom finish. We come to you across West London, 7 days a week.

Our Services

Eco-friendly car valeting & detailing services

From a mobile car wash and full valet to ceramic coating, paint correction and interior deep cleans — every service uses eco-friendly products and the latest equipment. Prices vary with size and condition, so every quote is free and tailored.

From £109Valeting

Mini & Full Valets

Inside-and-out valets — from a tidy mini valet to our deluxe full valet. Vacuum, steam, deep clean, protect and finish.

Book this service
From £289Detailing

Premium & Supercar Detailing

Meticulous, multi-stage detailing for classics, supercars and high-end vehicles — the perfectionist's choice.

Book this service
From £289Paintwork

Paint Correction & Ceramic

Machine polishing, swirl & scratch removal, paint enhancement and long-lasting ceramic coating protection.

Book this service
From £189Interior

Interior Deep Clean & Steam

Steam sanitisation, stain & odour removal, mould treatment and ozone — a fresh, hygienic, allergy-friendly cabin.

Book this service
From £189Specialist

Soft-Top Cleaning & Proofing

Convertible roof deep clean, re-colour and re-proofing to keep fabric tops protected from the British weather.

Book this service

Restoration & Refurb

Alloy wheel refurbishment, dent & scuff repair and bodywork respraying — restore resale value before you sell.

Book this service
From £289Valeting

Lease Return & Post-Purchase Valet

Handing a lease back? We deep clean the areas inspectors check to help you avoid end-of-lease charges. Just bought used? A full reset removes the previous owner's dirt, stains & odours.

Book this service
Quote on requestInterior

Mould & Odour Removal

Mould thrives in damp cabins — we remove it at the source with eco-friendly steam sanitisation, stain treatment and ozone for stubborn, deeply embedded odours.

View service
From £189Paintwork

Machine Polishing & Paint Protection

Single or multi-stage machine polish to lift swirls and restore gloss — finished with wax, sealant or ceramic to lock in the shine.

Book this service
Why West London Drivers Choose Ecoverde

Genuinely green — not just a label

Eco isn't a marketing word for us — it's how every job is done. Better for your car's finish, better for your family's health, and better for the planet.

Low-water & waterless techniques

Steam and rinseless washing lift dirt with a fraction of the water — no run-off, no waste.

Plant-based, biodegradable products

Solvent-free, pH-balanced, non-toxic shampoos and interior cleaners — safe for allergy-sensitive clients.

Electric van — zero generator

We arrive fully self-powered and emission-free, so there's no noisy generator on your driveway.

Meticulous, perfectionist finish

Attention to detail on every panel — the high standard that earns 560+ five-star reviews.

How It Works

Simple to book. No rigid calendars.

Because every car is different, we quote on the job — not a fixed price list. You request a time that suits, we confirm and assess, and you only pay once you're happy with the quote.

01

Request a visit

Send a few photos or a short video, choose a time that suits you, and tell us what you need.

02

Free, tailored quote

We assess the size and condition and call you with a no-obligation quote — we work around your budget.

03

We come to you

Our fully-mobile, eco-friendly setup arrives at your home or office — no driving, no waiting rooms.

04

Spotless & protected

Meticulous results, every time. Loved it? Easy reminders keep your car looking its best year-round.

We only quote once we've seen the car, so you always know exactly what you're paying for.

Meet The Founder

Hi, I'm John — a perfectionist with a passion for cars

I started Ecoverde with one belief: your car should look incredible without costing the earth — literally. For over 8 years I've brought high-end, fully-mobile car care to driveways and offices across West London, using eco-friendly products and the latest equipment on everything from daily drivers to supercars and classics.

I treat every car like my own. That's why I never quote without seeing the job, always work around your budget, and don't leave until it's spotless.

— John Muriel, Founder

Satisfaction guaranteed

If you're not completely happy, we make it right. Simple as that.

Recent Work · Before & After

Car valeting before & after in West London

Service Areas

Mobile car valeting across West London & beyond

Ecoverde Valeting is a fully mobile, eco-friendly car valeting and detailing service for car owners across West London, including busy professionals, families, and luxury and classic car enthusiasts. We come to your home or workplace from our bases in Ladbroke Grove (W10) and Brentford (TW8). Not sure if we reach you? Just ask.

Car valeting gift vouchers

A gift for someone who loves their car, or for anyone who would rather not spend a Saturday cleaning one. Vouchers are personalised, sent by email and redeemable anywhere across our West London coverage. Open value cards start at £25.

  • Sent by email. Personalised with your message and delivered digitally, so there is nothing to post and nothing to arrive late.
  • Any service, any area. Redeemable against any valet or detailing service, anywhere we cover across West London.
  • Open value from £25. Put any amount on it, or choose a specific service if you already know what they want.

Browse gift vouchers

Just bought a used car?

Our Used Car Fresh Start Valet deep cleans and steam sanitises the whole interior, then treats smoke, pet, damp and food smells at the source rather than covering them up. Fully mobile across West London, from £189.

Why valet a used car after buying it?

You don't know how the last owner used it. Seats, carpets, vents and the steering wheel hold dirt, bacteria and old smells, so a deep clean and steam sanitisation gives you a hygienic start.

How long does it take?

Usually 2 to 4 hours, depending on the size of the car and its condition.

Ready When You Are

Get your free, no-obligation quote

Send a quick photo or video of your car and we'll come back with a tailored quote. Fully mobile, fully eco, across West London — 7 days a week.

Message on WhatsApp Call 07495 400369
Questions & Answers

Everything you need to know

Can a mobile car valeting service come to my home or office?
Yes — Ecoverde is a fully mobile service covering West London, including Brentford (TW8), Ladbroke Grove (W10), Chiswick and surrounding areas. We arrive at your home, office car park or outdoor space with all the equipment and eco-friendly products we need.
Which mobile car valeting companies use eco-friendly cleaning products?
We use biodegradable, non-toxic, pH-balanced products exclusively. We employ low-water and waterless wash techniques, solvent-free formulations that are safe for paintwork, and we responsibly dispose of all waste materials.
Where can I find a mobile car valeting service with great reviews nearby?
Ecoverde has earned 560+ five-star reviews across Google, Checkatrade, Bark, Facebook and Yell. We're Checkatrade verified and consistently praised for attention to detail, punctuality and professionalism.
Do you offer ceramic coating treatments?
Yes — we apply professional ceramic coating at your location, creating a hydrophobic layer that repels water, protects against UV damage and lasts for years.
Do you include interior deep cleaning and upholstery shampoo?
We provide full upholstery shampooing, steam cleaning, leather conditioning, stain and odour removal, vacuuming and glass cleaning — all using eco-friendly solutions.
What paint protection options are available?
Options include carnauba wax, synthetic paint sealant, ceramic coating, and paint correction to remove swirl marks and oxidisation.
Do you offer a quick turnaround for busy schedules?
Our express mini valet takes 45–60 minutes; a full valet takes 2–3 hours. We offer flexible time slots including early mornings, daytime and weekends.
Can you valet a luxury or classic car?
Absolutely. We regularly service luxury brands (BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Porsche), Range Rover, Tesla and classic vehicles, using paint-safe, hand-application techniques throughout.
Do you offer contactless booking and payment?
Yes — request a free quote online any time, pay by contactless digital payment, receive confirmations via WhatsApp, and enjoy a full end-to-end contactless service.
Do you use steam cleaning technology?
We use professional-grade steam cleaning that eliminates bacteria and odours without chemicals, penetrates hard-to-reach areas, and uses minimal water.

Home/Services/Car Detailing
Car Detailing

Car detailing & ceramic coating

Multi-stage detailing, paint correction and long-lasting ceramic protection for a flawless, mirror finish — at your home or office.

From £289 · free tailored quote

Last updated: November 2026

Call 07495 400369
What's Included

A flawless, protected finish

Looking for professional car detailing and paint protection in West London? Ecoverde Valeting brings specialist detailing to your home or workplace. Whether you own a Porsche, a Ferrari, a luxury saloon or a cherished classic, our paint correction removes swirl marks and light scratches, and ceramic coating helps protect your paintwork for 1 to 5 years, depending on the product and how the car is maintained. Detailing starts from £289, and every quote is tailored to your car's condition.

Who applies your ceramic coatings? Our founder, John Muriel, is an IGL Ceramic Coating Certified Installer, so your coating is applied by someone trained and certified by IGL Coatings.

  • Paint decontamination & clay treatment
  • Machine polishing to remove swirls & scratches
  • Paint correction & gloss enhancement
  • Ceramic coating, sealant or premium wax
  • Glass, trim & alloy wheel sealing
Detailing Options

Detailing & protection

Prices depend on your car's size, paint condition and finish — every quote is free and tailored.

Machine Polishing

Can machine polishing remove swirl marks? Yes. If your car has light swirl marks, fine scratches or dull paintwork, a single-stage machine polish brings back gloss and clarity, from £189. For deeper marks, multi-stage paint correction starts from £289. We look at your paintwork at your home or workplace and recommend the right level.

From £189

Machine Polishing — FAQs

What’s the difference between single-stage and multi-stage polishing?
A: Single-stage enhances gloss and removes light marks, while multi-stage corrects deeper imperfections for a near-flawless finish.
How long does machine polishing last?
A: The finish can last months if maintained with proper washing and protection.
Can machine polishing damage my paint?
A: Not when done professionally. We use safe, controlled techniques.
Should I add protection after polishing?
A: Yes — we recommend wax, sealant, or ceramic coating to preserve the results.

Paint Correction & Protection

Multi-stage correction to remove swirls and scratches, finished with a durable sealant that locks in the shine.

From £289

Paint Correction & Protection — FAQs

What’s the difference between car paint correction and protection?
A: Correction removes defects (swirls, scratches), while protection (wax, sealant, or ceramic) locks in the finish.
Will it remove deep scratches?
A: It removes light to moderate scratches. Deeper ones may need paint respraying.
How long does protection last?
A: Wax lasts 6– 8 weeks , sealant 6–12 months, and ceramic coating up to 5 years.
Do you recommend ceramic coating after correction?
A: Yes — it’s the best way to preserve the freshly corrected finish.

Classic Car Detailing

Gentle, paint-safe detailing for classic and vintage cars — delicate products and techniques that respect original finishes.

From £289
View full service

Classic Car Detailing — FAQs

Is this safe for older vehicles?
A: Yes — we use period-correct, gentle cleaning products and safe techniques suited to vintage finishes.
Can you detail soft-top roofs?
A: Absolutely. We can clean and protect convertible roofs as an optional extra.
Do you use ceramic coatings on classic cars?
Yes, but only if suitable. Some older paints respond better to traditional waxes.

Supercar Detailing

The ultimate, discreet detail for supercars, sports and luxury vehicles — meticulous care for high-end paintwork.

From £349
View full service

Supercar Detailing — FAQs

Is this service discreet?
A: Yes — we provide a private, fully mobile service with complete confidentiality.
Do you use special products for supercars?
A: Yes — we only use ultra-safe, supercar-approved products and techniques.
How long does it take?
A: Between 5–8 hours, depending on the service level chosen.
Do you work on exotic brands like Ferrari, McLaren, and Lamborghini?
A: Yes — we regularly detail high-performance and luxury marques.

Ceramic Coating

Is ceramic coating worth it for a luxury or performance car? If you want longer-lasting protection and easier washing, yes. We decontaminate and machine polish the paint first, then apply a hydrophobic coating that repels water, resists road grime and keeps the gloss, with 1 to 5 years of protection depending on the coating and how the car is maintained. Every coating is applied at your home or workplace by an IGL Ceramic Coating Certified Installer.

From £399

Ceramic Coating — FAQs

How long does a ceramic coating last?
Typically 1–5 years depending on the product chosen and how the car is maintained.
Do you prepare the paint before coating?
Yes — a full decontamination and machine polish first, so the coating locks in the best possible finish.
Can you apply it at my home or work?
Yes, ceramic coating is applied fully mobile across West London.

Leather Upholstery Detailing

A deep clean and condition for leather seats and trim — lifting grime and restoring suppleness.

From £95
View full service

Leather Upholstery Detailing — FAQs

How do you clean and protect car leather seats?

Valeting Service

Mobile car valeting, brought to your door

A thorough deep clean inside and out — from a quick refresh to our deluxe full valet. Fully mobile across West London, using eco-friendly products only.

From £109 · free tailored quote

Last updated: November 2026

Call 07495 400369
What's Included

A spotless finish, inside & out

What does a professional mobile car valet include?

At Ecoverde Valeting, we bring professional car cleaning directly to your home or workplace across West London. Our valeting services include exterior hand washing, wheel cleaning, interior vacuuming, steam sanitisation and specialist treatments depending on your chosen package. We use biodegradable cleaning products and professional equipment to give your vehicle a thorough, hygienic clean without requiring a trip to the car wash. Prices start from £109 for a Mini Valet, with free quotations tailored to your vehicle.

Professional mobile car valeting across West London, with Mini Valets starting from £109 and taking approximately 60–90 minutes, Deluxe Full Valets from £189 taking up to 2 hours, and Extreme Full Plus Valets from £239 taking approximately 3–4 hours. Every service uses biodegradable cleaning products and professional equipment. Prices reviewed: November 2026.

  • Exterior hand wash, wheels, tyres & glass
  • Full interior vacuum, steam clean & sanitise
  • Upholstery & carpet shampoo, leather conditioning
  • Stain & odour removal, mould treatment
  • Wax or sealant finish to protect the paintwork
Valet Packages

Choose your level of clean

Prices are a guide and depend on your car's size and condition — every quote is free and tailored.

Mini Valet

We understand not every car needs a full valet — if you keep yours in good shape, a light refresh brings back that spotless look. Perfect for regularly maintained vehicles.

Up to 90 minsFrom £109

Mini Valet — FAQs

How long does a Mini Valet take?
Around 60–90 minutes, depending on your car's size and condition.
Is the Mini Valet a deep clean?
It's a light refresh — exterior wash plus an interior tidy, vacuum and wipe-down. For heavier build-up choose the Deluxe or Interior Deep Clean.
Do you come to me?
Yes — we're fully mobile across West London and bring everything we need, including water and power.

Deluxe Full Valet

When should I choose a Deluxe Full Valet instead of a Mini Valet?

If your car needs more than a routine clean, our Deluxe Full Valet provides a thorough interior and exterior deep clean at your home or workplace in West London. Starting from £189, this service is designed for drivers who want to refresh their vehicle's appearance and tackle accumulated dirt. The service typically takes up to 2 hours, although larger or heavily soiled vehicles may require additional time. If you're unsure which package suits your car, send us a photo for a free, personalised recommendation.

Up to 2 hrsFrom £189

Deluxe Full Valet — FAQs

How long does a Deluxe Full Valet take?
On average, this service takes up to 2 hours, but larger or heavily soiled vehicles may take longer.
Do I need to provide water or electricity?
No — our service is fully mobile, and we bring everything needed, including water, power, and eco-friendly cleaning products.
Will this service remove all stains and odours?
Most light to moderate stains and odours can be treated effectively. For severe cases, we recommend our specialist deep cleaning or odour removal packages.
How often should I book a Deluxe Full Valet?
We recommend this service every 2–3 months to keep your vehicle in top condition, but it can also be booked ahead of special events, lease returns, or sales. Deluxe Full Valet Our Deluxe Full Valet is the ultimate treatment for drivers who want their car looking and feeling its absolute best. Combining a full exterior refresh with a deep interior clean Starting from £189 up to 2 hrs ⚠️ Please Note: Prices for our Deluxe Full Valet may vary depending on the size, type, and overall condition of your vehicle. Heavily soiled interiors, excessive pet hair, or stubborn stains may require a

Interior Deep Clean Valet

When a standard valet isn't enough — months of build-up, stubborn stains or lingering odours. A full interior reset with steam, shampoo & sanitising.

2–4 hrsFrom £189

Interior Deep Clean Valet — FAQs

Will this service clean the whole interior?
A: Yes — every interior surface is cleaned and refreshed.
How long does it take?
A: Usually 2–4 hours depending on vehicle size and condition.
Does it include exterior cleaning?
A: No — this service focuses purely on the interior. For a full service, check our Extreme Full Plus Valet.

Extreme Full Plus Valet

An even more thorough, bespoke clean & detail of your exterior & interior. More than a clean — protect your car's value, including leather care and spray-on wax.

Up to 4 hrsFrom £239

Extreme Full Plus Valet — FAQs

Who is this service for?
A: Cars in poor condition or vehicles needing a complete reset.
How long does it take?
A: 3-4 hours depending on the size of the vehicle.

Post-Purchase / Pre-Sale Valet

Start fresh with a professionally cleaned vehicle — showroom-ready before you buy, sell or hand back a lease. A complete reset, inside and out.

3–5 hrsFrom £289
Pre-Sale details

Post-Purchase / Pre-Sale Valet — FAQs

Why book a Post-Purchase Valet?
A: To remove bacteria, stains, odours, and hidden dirt left by previous owners.
How long does it take?
A: Around 3–5 hours depending on vehicle size and condition.

Soft-Top Decontamination & Proofing

A full decontamination of your convertible roof. A deep extraction clean lifts ingrained dirt, algae and mould out of the fabric, then a premium proofer protects it against rain, UV and future staining.

Around 2 hrsFrom £189
Soft-Top details

Soft-Top Decontamination & Proofing FAQs

How often does a soft top need reproofing?
A: Every 6 to 12 months for most convertibles. Once rain soaks in and darkens the fabric instead of beading off, the proofing has gone.
Is it safe for mohair and canvas roofs?
A: Yes. We identify the fabric first and use soft-top-safe brushes and products, never a pressure washer. Vinyl roofs are treated separately with a vinyl cleaner.

Just bought a used car?

Our Used Car Fresh Start Valet deep cleans and steam sanitises the whole interior, then treats smoke, pet, damp and food smells at the source rather than covering them up. Fully mobile across West London, from £189.

Why valet a used car after buying it?

You don't know how the last owner used it. Seats, carpets, vents and the steering wheel hold dirt, bacteria and old smells, so a deep clean and steam sanitisation gives you a hygienic start.

How long does it take?

Usually 2 to 4 hours, depending on the size of the car and its condition.

If you would rather not book each valet one at a time, our maintenance packages cover regular visits on a set schedule, from £75 a month.

Home/Car Restoration/Alloy Wheel Refurbishment
Alloy Wheel Refurbishment · West London

Alloy Wheel Refurbishment

Restore Your Wheels to Like-New Condition

Call 07495 400369

Professional Alloy Wheel Repair & Refinishing in London

Damaged or scuffed alloy wheels don’t just spoil the look of your car — they can also reduce resale value and give the impression of poor maintenance . At Ecoverde Valeting , our alloy wheel refurbishment service in London repairs, restores, and refinishes your wheels, leaving them safe, smooth, and visually flawless .

We work with precision and care to bring your alloys back to a factory-fresh finish, using professional techniques and high-quality materials for long-lasting results.

Why Alloy Wheel Refurbishment Is Important

Kerb damage, corrosion, scratches, and brake dust buildup can quickly ruin the appearance of alloy wheels. If left untreated, damage can worsen over time and impact the overall condition of your vehicle.

Our refurbishment service helps to:

What’s Included in Our Alloy Wheel Refurbishment Service

Every wheel is carefully inspected before work begins to ensure the right repair method is used.

  • Full Wheel Inspection We assess kerb damage, corrosion, paint condition, and structural integrity before starting any repair.
  • Kerb Rash & Scratch Repair Scuffs, scrapes, and surface damage are professionally repaired to restore smooth edges and clean lines.
  • Surface Preparation Wheels are cleaned, sanded, and prepared to ensure a flawless base for refinishing.
  • Wheel Refinishing & Colour Restoration We restore the original colour or refinish the wheel for a clean, uniform finish that matches the factory look.
  • Protective Coating Application A durable protective coating is applied to help resist brake dust, road grime, and corrosion.

How the Process Works

  • Send Photos or Book an Inspection
  • Receive an Honest Assessment & Quote
  • Professional Repair & Refinishing
  • Final Inspection for Quality & Safety

We only recommend repairs that are necessary — no upselling, no hidden costs.

Honest Assessment

What we can repair, and what needs a workshop

We are a mobile service, so it is worth being straight about where that helps and where it does not. Most wheel damage is cosmetic and we can put it right at your address. Some damage is structural, and no honest mobile outfit should touch it.

DamageMobile repair?Notes
Kerb rash and scuffsYesThe most common job by far. Sanded back, filled where needed, refinished and sealed.
Lacquer peel and corrosionYesThe affected area is stripped back to sound metal before refinishing.
Deep gougesUsuallyDepends how deep. We will tell you honestly once we have seen photos.
Cracked, buckled or splitNoThat is a structural repair needing specialist welding or straightening. We will refer you rather than risk it.
Diamond-cut facesRefinish onlyRecutting the machined face needs a lathe in a workshop. We can refinish the wheel in a solid or powder-look colour, but we cannot restore the cut pattern.

If a wheel is not safe to repair we will say so. A wheel that has been welded badly or skimmed too thin is a genuine hazard at motorway speed.

Finishes

The four wheel finishes, and how they behave

Knowing which finish your wheels have tells you what can be done with them and how they will wear afterwards.

FinishHow it looksWeak point
Painted or powder-coatedSolid colour, silver through to satin blackChips at the rim edge; otherwise very durable
Diamond-cutBright machined face under lacquerWater gets under the lacquer and creates a cloudy white bloom
PolishedMirror-bright bare metalNeeds frequent hand polishing or it dulls quickly
Satin and matteFlat, no glossCannot be machine polished; marks show and cannot be buffed out

Most cars sold in the UK come on painted or powder-coated wheels, which is the finish that suits mobile refurbishment best.

Pricing

What changes the price

Wheel refurbishment is quoted per wheel, and four things move the number.

  • Wheel diameter. A 22 inch wheel is a great deal more surface area than a 17 inch one.
  • The finish. A straightforward silver or black refinish costs less than a two-tone or a specialist colour match.
  • How bad the damage is. Light scuffing on one rim is a different job from corrosion across all four.
  • How many wheels. A set of four is better value per wheel than a single repair.
  • Whether the tyre has to come off. Damage right at the rim lip sometimes means removing the tyre, which adds time.

Send us photographs of each damaged wheel, straight on and from an angle, and we will come back with a firm figure rather than a range.

Afterwards

Looking after refurbished wheels

  • Leave them a week before the first wash so the finish fully hardens.
  • Avoid acidic wheel cleaners. They are sold as fast-acting and they will attack a fresh finish.
  • Use a pH-neutral shampoo and a soft wheel brush, never a stiff bristle or a scouring pad.
  • Rinse brake dust off regularly rather than letting it bake on. Hot dust is mildly corrosive.
  • Take care at kerbs. Nothing we apply will make a wheel resistant to concrete.
FAQs

Frequently asked questions

Can all alloy wheel damage be repaired?
Most cosmetic damage such as kerb rash, scratches, and corrosion can be repaired. We’ll advise if a wheel is beyond safe refurbishment.
How long does alloy wheel refurbishment take?
Minor repairs can often be completed within a few hours . Timeframes depend on the level of damage and number of wheels.
Will refurbished wheels last?
Yes. With proper preparation and protective coatings, refurbished wheels are durable and designed to withstand everyday driving conditions.
Will alloy wheel refurbishment affect my car’s safety?
No. Our refurbishment process focuses on cosmetic restoration only and does not compromise the structural integrity of your wheels. Every wheel is inspected before work begins, and if any safety concerns are identified, we’ll advise you honestly before proceeding. Why Choose Ecoverde Valeting Over 8 years of experience in vehicle care and restoration Fully insured, professional service High-quality workmanship with no shortcuts Honest advice and transparent pricing Trusted by drivers across West London At Ecoverde, we take pride in restoring the finer details — because it’s the details that make the difference. Starting from
How much does alloy wheel refurbishment cost in London?
Refurbishment is priced per wheel and depends on diameter, finish and how bad the damage is. A light kerb scuff on one wheel sits at the lower end and a corroded set of four at the upper. Send us photos of each wheel and we will give you an exact figure before you book, with nothing added afterwards.
Can you refurbish diamond-cut alloy wheels?
Only partly. Restoring the machined face of a diamond-cut wheel needs a CNC lathe in a workshop, which is not something any mobile service can carry. We can strip and refinish a diamond-cut wheel in a solid colour, which many owners prefer because it is far more durable, but we cannot recut the pattern.
Do the tyres need to come off?
Usually not. Most kerb damage sits on the face and outer rim where we can mask the tyre and work around it. Where the damage runs right onto the rim lip, or the wheel needs stripping back completely, the tyre has to come off and we will tell you that at the quote stage.
Can you repair a cracked or buckled wheel?
No, and you should be wary of anyone who offers to at your kerbside. Cracks and buckles are structural, and repairing them properly means specialist welding or straightening equipment. We will inspect it, tell you what we can see, and point you to a workshop that does that work.
How long do refurbished alloy wheels last?
A properly prepared and sealed wheel should hold its finish for years of ordinary use. The preparation decides it: paint applied over corrosion that was not fully removed will lift again within months, which is why we strip back to sound metal rather than covering damage over.
Can you change the colour of my alloys?
Yes. Refinishing in a different colour is popular, satin black and anthracite most of all. It is worth thinking about resale first, as an unusual colour narrows the pool of buyers, and about consistency, since all four wheels need doing together for a uniform result.
Is it worth refurbishing alloys before selling the car?
Almost always. Scuffed wheels are one of the first things a buyer notices and they suggest the car has been treated carelessly, whether or not that is true. Tidy wheels typically return more than they cost on the sale price and they make the car far easier to sell quickly.
Will refurbished wheels be easier to keep clean?
Yes. A fresh sealed surface is smooth, so brake dust sits on top rather than working into pitted or peeling lacquer. A rinse and a pH-neutral shampoo will usually be enough where before you may have been scrubbing.

Please note: prices for wheel refurbishment vary depending on the size, type and condition of your wheels — every quote is free and tailored.

Home/Car Detailing/Ceramic Coating & Paint Protection
Ceramic Coating & Paint Protection · West London

Car Ceramic Coating

Give your car the best defence against the elements with our Car Ceramic Coating Service . At Ecoverde Valeting, we specialise in applying professional-grade ceramic coatings that create a durable, high-gloss barrier on your vehicle’s paintwork. This advanced protection resists dirt, water, UV rays, and light scratches, while making your car easier to clean and maintain.

Call 07495 400369

What’s Included in the Service ?

  • Safe pre-wash and two-bucket hand wash using pH-neutral shampoo
  • Full decontamination (tar, iron, and fallout removal)
  • Machine polishing to refine paintwork and enhance clarity
  • Application of premium-grade ceramic coating
  • Hydrophobic layer for water and dirt repellence
  • UV protection to prevent fading and oxidation
  • Tyres, trims, and glass treated for a complete finish

Why Choose us For Your Car Ceramic Coating?

  • Long-lasting protection (1–5 years, depending on product)
  • High-gloss, showroom-level finish
  • Makes maintenance washes quicker and easier
  • Protects against UV rays, road grime, and contaminants
  • Ideal for both new cars and freshly detailed paintwork
What It Costs

Ceramic coating prices in West London

Our paint protection starts from £399. Ceramic prices vary enormously between installers, which makes quotes hard to compare, so here is what actually moves the number.

  • The size of the car. A supermini and a large SUV are not the same amount of panel, product or time.
  • The condition of the paint. Most of the labour is preparation. Where a car needs significant correction we quote for that separately and explain why, rather than folding it into a single figure.
  • The grade of coating. Longer-lasting professional coatings cost more than a hybrid product.
  • Whether trims, glass and wheels are included. We will tell you what is in the price before you book.

Send us a few photos of the car and we will come back with an exact figure. Nothing changes on the day.

The Process

How we apply it

Steps one to four are most of the labour and most of the cost. A quote that is dramatically cheaper than everyone else has usually skipped them.

  1. 1
    Decontamination wash

    A safe pre-wash and two-bucket hand wash to lift surface grime without marring the paint.

  2. 2
    Chemical decontamination and clay

    Bonded iron, tar and industrial fallout are drawn out of the paint. A coating applied over contamination seals it in.

  3. 3
    Machine polishing

    Where the paint needs correcting, we refine it first. Coating over swirl marks locks them in for years.

  4. 4
    Panel wipe

    Every trace of polishing oil is stripped off, otherwise the coating cannot bond properly.

  5. 5
    Coating applied panel by panel

    Applied in sections and levelled at the right moment, which is the part that decides whether the finish is even.

  6. 6
    Initial cure

    The car must stay dry for the first 12 to 24 hours while the coating hardens.

Choosing

Which grade suits your car

Ceramic coatings are not one product. The right grade depends on how long you are keeping the car and how much preparation the paint needs.

TypeDurabilityBest for
Professional grade2 to 5 yearsCars you are keeping; dark or new paintwork
Consumer gradeUp to 2 yearsEnthusiasts happy to do the preparation themselves
Hybrid1 to 2 yearsA step up from wax without full coating cost

Ceramic, wax or paint protection film?

OptionLastsTrade-off
Carnauba wax4 to 8 weeksWarm gloss and cheap, but breaks down over winter
Synthetic sealant4 to 6 monthsGood value and sharp gloss, less durable than a coating
Ceramic coating2 to 5 yearsChemical resistance and easy washing, but will not stop stone chips
Paint protection film5 to 10 yearsPhysical chip protection, considerably more expensive

They are not mutually exclusive. Film on the high-impact front end with a coating over the rest is a common combination. If you want the longer read, see our guide to ceramic coating cost, benefits and how long it lasts.

Afterwards

Looking after a coated car

  • No washing at all for the first seven days while the coating fully hardens.
  • Wash with a pH-neutral shampoo. Harsh detergents shorten a coating’s life.
  • Use the two-bucket method with a clean mitt, never a brush.
  • Avoid automatic car washes entirely. Spinning brushes undo the work faster than anything else.
  • Dry with a soft towel or blown air to prevent water spotting.
  • Remove bird droppings and tree sap promptly, even on a coated car.

A ceramic maintenance spray every few months refreshes the water repellency and extends the coating’s useful life. We will show you what to use before we leave.

Red flags when comparing quotes

  • “Ceramic coating, one hour, £99.” That is a ceramic-infused spray sealant, not a coating.
  • No mention of polishing on a car with visible swirl marks.
  • A promise that it can be applied in the rain.
  • A ten year guarantee with no maintenance schedule attached.

Wondering whether it can be done properly on your driveway? We answer that honestly in can ceramic coating be applied at your home?

FAQs

Frequently asked questions

How long does a ceramic coating last?
Typically 1–5 years depending on the product chosen and how the car is maintained.
Do you prepare the paint before coating?
Yes — a full decontamination and machine polish first, so the coating bonds to clean, refined paint for the best finish.
Does it make washing easier?
Yes — the hydrophobic layer repels water and dirt, so maintenance washes are quicker and the gloss lasts longer.
Can you apply it at my home or work?
Yes, ceramic coating is applied fully mobile across West London.
How much does ceramic coating cost in West London?
Our paint protection starts from £399. The final figure depends on the size of the car, the condition of the paint and the grade of coating you choose. Send us photos and we will confirm an exact price before you book.
How long does the job take?
Most ceramic coating jobs take a full day, because the preparation is the bulk of the work. The car then needs to stay dry for the first 12 to 24 hours while the coating cures.
Do I need to keep the car in a garage afterwards?
It helps for the first day but it is not essential. The important thing is that the car stays dry for 12 to 24 hours, and that you do not wash it at all for the first seven days.
Will a ceramic coating stop stone chips?
No. A coating gives chemical resistance, gloss and much easier washing, but it will not absorb physical impact. Paint protection film is what stops chips, and the two are often combined on the front end.
Is Ecoverde certified to apply ceramic coatings?
Yes. We are IGL Ceramic Coating certified and we use professional-grade products rather than consumer sprays.
Can you coat a car that already has swirl marks?
We would machine polish it first. Applying a coating over swirl marks seals them in for the life of the coating, which can be several years, so correction comes first wherever the paint needs it.

A coating lasts longest when the car is washed properly between details. Our maintenance packages keep it that way on a regular schedule, from £75 a month.

Free, No-Obligation Quote

Book your ceramic coating today

Protect your paintwork with a professional ceramic coating — fully mobile across West London, 7 days a week. Send a photo and we'll come back with a free, tailored quote.

Interior Deep Clean, Steam & Mould Removal · West London

Your West London Car Interior Deep Clean

Imagine stepping into your car and being greeted not by the lingering scent of yesterday’s coffee or the faint trace of muddy footprints, but by a fresh, revitalised cabin. A truly clean car interior does more than just look good; it transforms your driving experience, offering a sanctuary on wheels. In the bustling heart of West London, maintaining this pristine environment can feel like a constant battle.

From £189 · free tailored quote

Last updated: November 2026

Call 07495 400369

Rediscover Your Car’s Interior: The Ultimate Deep Clean Experience in West London

Your car’s interior is more than just a mode of transport; it’s an extension of your personal space. Over time, even with diligent everyday cleaning, a buildup of dirt, allergens, and microscopic particles can accumulate, impacting both the aesthetics and the air quality within your vehicle. A professional deep clean goes far beyond a quick vacuum and wipe-down, addressing the often-overlooked areas that harbour the most grime. It’s about restoring that “new car” feeling, ensuring every surface is meticulously treated, from the deepest crevices of the upholstery to the intricate vents of your dashboard.

In West London, where busy lifestyles and urban conditions can accelerate wear and tear, investing in a comprehensive interior valet is crucial for maintaining your vehicle’s comfort and value. Think about the hours you spend commuting, running errands, or embarking on weekend adventures – all within your car. A clean, sanitised interior contributes significantly to a more pleasant and healthy driving environment. Our aim is to provide an experience that revitalises your vehicle, making every journey more enjoyable and reflecting your commitment to quality and care. This process isn’t just about superficial tidiness; it’s about a thorough rejuvenation of your car’s living space, making it a true pleasure to inhabit.

What Does a ‘Deep Clean’ for Your Car Interior Actually Involve?

What does a professional car interior deep clean include? If you have recently bought a used car, or your cabin has simply had a hard year, our interior deep clean removes the dirt, stains and lingering smells left behind. We start by inspecting the seats, carpets, upholstery and hard-to-reach areas, then use specialist equipment, steam and targeted treatments to clean every surface, from the glove box to the door bins. Interior deep cleans start from £189 and usually take 2 to 4 hours, depending on the size of the car and its condition.

Beyond a Quick Wipe-Down: Identifying Hidden Grime

The distinction between a quick clean and a deep clean lies in the unseen. Hidden grime can include everything from dried food particles and spilled drinks that have seeped into seams, to skin cells, pet dander, and dust mites in your upholstery and carpets. These particles, often microscopic, contribute to unpleasant odours and can trigger allergies for occupants. Think about the areas around seatbelt retractors, the undersides of seats, and the intricate patterns in floor mats – these are prime spots where dirt accumulates and is difficult to remove with standard cleaning methods. We also pay close attention to the air vents, which can harbour dust and mould spores, circulating them throughout the cabin with every use. Identifying these hidden sources of dirt and odour is the first critical step in a truly effective deep clean, ensuring we address the root causes of interior degradation.

The Importance of Professional Attention to Detail

Professional car valeters possess the expertise, tools, and specialised products necessary to achieve a level of clean that is difficult to replicate at home. Our technicians are trained to identify different types of stains and know the most effective, material-safe methods for their removal. They understand the nuances of cleaning various surfaces, from delicate leather and Alcantara to durable automotive fabrics and plastics. For instance, using the wrong cleaner on leather can cause discolouration or cracking, while inadequate vacuuming of carpets can leave behind allergens that impact respiratory health. Our attention to detail means we meticulously work on every seam, crevice, and surface, ensuring a consistent and thorough clean. We also employ techniques like gentle steam cleaning to sanitise and deodorise without harsh chemicals, providing a healthier environment. This focus on precision and material integrity is what sets a professional deep clean apart.

Tailoring the Clean to Your Vehicle’s Needs

Every car is unique, and so are its interior cleaning requirements. A family car with young children will have different cleaning challenges than a luxury performance vehicle or a commercial van. At Ecoverde Valeting, we recognise this and tailor our deep cleaning approach accordingly. For vehicles with leather interiors, we use specific leather conditioners to protect and nourish the material, preventing cracks and preserving its suppleness. Fabric upholstery might require specialised stain removers and deep extraction methods to lift embedded dirt and spills. For higher-end vehicles, we are particularly careful with delicate trim and electronic components. We also consider the age and condition of the interior, adapting our methods to ensure the best possible results without causing damage. This customised approach ensures that your car receives the most effective and appropriate treatment, maintaining its aesthetic appeal and structural integrity for years to come.

Why Mobile Car Valeting is Your West London Solution

In the dynamic environment of West London, convenience is paramount. Mobile car valeting services offer a significant advantage by bringing professional-grade cleaning directly to your doorstep, whether that’s your home or workplace. Instead of dedicating time to drive to a car wash, wait for the service, and then travel back, you can continue with your day uninterrupted. This mobile model is particularly beneficial for busy professionals and families who have limited free time. Our fully equipped vans carry everything needed to perform a comprehensive valeting service, including water, power, and all the necessary cleaning agents and equipment. This means we can operate efficiently in most locations, providing a premium service without requiring you to alter your schedule. It’s about reclaiming your time and enjoying a professionally cleaned car with minimal disruption to your routine. For residents in areas like Brentford TW8 and Ladbroke Grove W10, this offers a seamless way to maintain their vehicles.

Unparalleled Convenience: We Come to You in Brentford TW8 & Ladbroke Grove W10

The core benefit of our mobile service is the unparalleled convenience it offers to residents and workers across West London. Forget the hassle of scheduling appointments at a fixed location or navigating busy city traffic to get there. Whether you’re at home in Brentford TW8, at work in Ladbroke Grove W10, or anywhere in between, our team arrives at your chosen location and time. This flexibility allows you to have your car meticulously cleaned while you focus on your work, family, or leisure activities. We operate discreetly and efficiently, ensuring minimal disruption to your surroundings. Our service is designed to fit seamlessly into your life, transforming the often-arduous task of car cleaning into a simple, stress-free experience. This ‘we come to you’ model redefines car care, making it more accessible and less time-consuming than ever before.

Saving Your Precious Time: More Freedom, Less Hassle

Time is one of our most valuable commodities, especially in a fast-paced city like London. Traditional car washes and valeting centres demand a significant time commitment, often involving travel, waiting periods, and time away from your usual activities. Our mobile valeting service dramatically reduces this time investment. While we expertly clean your vehicle, you can attend meetings, spend time with family, or simply relax. This means less time spent waiting and more time dedicated to what truly matters to you. We bring the entire operation to you, eliminating the need for you to drive anywhere or rearrange your schedule. The efficiency of our mobile setup allows us to complete a comprehensive service promptly, giving you back precious hours in your day and a sparkling clean car as a result.

Protecting Your Investment: Maintaining High-End Vehicle Value

Your car is a significant investment, and maintaining its condition is key to preserving its value, especially for higher-end or luxury models. Regular, professional valeting, including interior deep cleaning, plays a crucial role in this. It prevents the gradual degradation of materials caused by dirt, UV exposure, and general wear and tear. A pristine interior not only enhances your driving pleasure but also significantly impacts the resale value of your vehicle. Potential buyers are more inclined to pay a premium for a car that has been meticulously cared for. Our eco-friendly approach also ensures that materials are treated with care, avoiding harsh chemicals that can damage surfaces over time. Consistent professional maintenance, such as that offered through our comprehensive car detailing service in West London , safeguards your investment and ensures your vehicle looks its best for longer.

The Power of Eco-Friendly Steam Cleaning for a Sanitised Interior

Can steam cleaning sanitise a used car's interior? Yes. Steam lifts stubborn dirt and helps kill germs on suitable surfaces, such as the seats, carpets and the parts you touch every day. If you have bought a second-hand car and want to know it is properly clean, we steam treat the seats, carpets and frequently touched surfaces where appropriate. Because steam cleans with heat, it also cuts down on harsh chemicals, which suits families and anyone sensitive to strong smells.

Found mould or a damp smell in your car? Our car mould and odour removal treatment tackles it at the source.

Ecoverde’s Commitment to Sustainable Cleaning Methods

At Ecoverde Valeting, our name reflects our core philosophy: providing premium car valeting services with a strong emphasis on environmental responsibility. We are dedicated to minimising our ecological footprint by employing sustainable cleaning methods wherever possible. This includes our extensive use of eco-friendly cleaning products that are biodegradable and free from harsh solvents and toxins, ensuring they are safe for both your vehicle’s materials and the environment. Our adoption of steam cleaning technology further underscores this commitment, as it drastically reduces water consumption compared to traditional car washing techniques. We continuously seek out and implement innovative, green solutions in our valeting processes. This dedication ensures that you receive a superior clean that not only enhances your vehicle but also contributes to a healthier planet, offering peace of mind with every service we provide.

How Steam Eliminates Germs and Allergens Safely

The sanitising power of steam lies in its high temperature, typically exceeding 100°C (212°F). When this superheated vapour is applied to surfaces, it effectively kills a vast array of microscopic organisms, including bacteria, viruses, mould spores, and dust mites. These are common culprits behind unpleasant odours and can trigger allergies and respiratory issues for occupants. Unlike chemical sanitisers, steam achieves this elimination through a purely physical process, without leaving behind any chemical residues . This makes it an exceptionally safe method for cleaning interiors, particularly in vehicles used by children, pets, or individuals with sensitivities. Steam’s ability to penetrate deeply into fabrics and crevices ensures that sanitisation occurs thoroughly, reaching areas that are difficult to access with conventional cleaning tools, thus creating a healthier and more hygienic cabin environment.

Tackling Stubborn Stains and Odours with Nature’s Help

Stubborn stains and lingering odours can be a persistent challenge in car interiors, often defying standard cleaning efforts. Steam cleaning is remarkably effective at loosening and lifting even deeply ingrained stains from upholstery and carpets. The intense heat and moisture break down the molecular bonds of the stain, making it easier to blot away without harsh scrubbing that could damage fabrics. For odours, steam works by breaking down the volatile organic compounds (VOCs) that cause unpleasant smells, rather than simply masking them with fragrances. Coupled with our use of natural, pH-balanced cleaning agents and deodorisers derived from plant-based sources, we can effectively neutralise odours from sources like spilled milk, pet accidents, smoke, or musty dampness. This nature-assisted approach provides a powerful and safe solution for restoring freshness and cleanliness to your car’s interior.

Revitalising Upholstery and Surfaces: From Leather to Fabric

The interior of your vehicle is a canvas that reflects your lifestyle. Over time, even with regular use, surfaces like leather seats, fabric upholstery, dashboards, and door panels can lose their lustre, becoming dull, stained, or worn. A deep clean goes beyond a quick wipe-down; it involves carefully restoring each material to its optimal condition. This process not only enhances the visual appeal but also contributes to the longevity of your car’s interior components. When considering a professional service, look for specialists who understand the nuances of different materials, ensuring that harsh chemicals or abrasive techniques don’t cause irreversible damage. The goal is a revitalised cabin that feels as good as it looks, enhancing your driving experience significantly.

Expert Care for Leather: Conditioning and Protection

Leather interiors, often found in luxury and performance vehicles, require specialised attention. Over time, leather can dry out, leading to cracks and a stiff texture. Our deep cleaning process for leather begins with a thorough, yet gentle, cleaning to remove dirt, oils, and any contaminants that have accumulated in the grain. We then follow up with a premium-grade leather conditioner. This is not just a superficial dressing; it’s a product designed to penetrate the leather, replenishing lost oils and restoring its natural suppleness and elasticity. Proper conditioning helps to prevent cracking and fading , preserving the premium feel of your seats. We assess the type of leather to ensure the correct products are used, whether it’s aniline, semi-aniline, or pigmented. This meticulous approach ensures your leather remains comfortable, durable, and visually stunning for years to come. Consider our comprehensive car detailing services if you seek to maintain such high standards across your entire vehicle.

Deep Cleaning Fabric Seats: Removing Dirt and Grime

Fabric upholstery, while comfortable, is particularly prone to absorbing spills, dirt, and allergens, leading to stubborn stains and unpleasant odours. A deep clean for fabric seats involves a multi-step process that goes far beyond vacuuming. We utilise advanced extraction techniques, often combined with specialised eco-friendly cleaning solutions that are safe for upholstery and effective against tough grime. Our process aims to lift dirt from deep within the fibres, rather than just surface cleaning. The key is to thoroughly agitate the fabric and then extract the loosened dirt and cleaning solution, leaving the fabric revitalised and significantly cleaner. We pay close attention to high-traffic areas like the driver’s seat and entry points, where wear and dirt accumulation are most pronounced. The objective is to restore the fabric’s original colour and texture, making it feel fresh and hygienic. This meticulous attention prevents premature wear and ensures a healthier environment inside your car .

Restoring Dashboards and Trim to Their Former Glory

Your car’s dashboard, centre console, and door panels are exposed to constant sunlight, dust, and fingerprints, which can cause them to fade, become sticky, or develop hairline scratches. Restoring these surfaces involves a detailed cleaning regimen tailored to their specific materials, which can range from hard plastics and soft-touch finishes to intricate electronic controls. We use a variety of specialised, non-abrasive cleaners and detailing brushes to meticulously clean every nook and cranny, removing accumulated dust and grime. Following the cleaning, appropriate protectants are applied. These are not greasy or overly shiny but are designed to restore a factory-fresh look , provide UV protection to prevent future fading, and leave a subtle, non-slippery finish. This careful attention to detail ensures that these often-overlooked areas contribute to the overall premium feel of your car’s interior.

Conquering Pesky Interior Car Mould and Unpleasant Odours

Unpleasant odours and the presence of mould in a car’s interior are more than just an aesthetic issue; they can impact air quality and pose health risks. These problems often stem from moisture ingress, spills that haven’t been thoroughly dried, or poor ventilation. Identifying the root cause is the crucial first step to eradicating them permanently. Driving a car that smells musty or has visible mould can be a deeply unpleasant experience, detracting from the enjoyment of your vehicle and potentially causing respiratory discomfort. Our specialised services are designed to tackle these issues head-on, providing not just a temporary fix but a lasting solution for a fresh and healthy cabin environment. We understand the specific challenges West London’s climate and traffic can present, and our methods are calibrated to combat these effectively.

Identifying the Source of Mould and Bad Smells

Effective odour and mould removal starts with precise diagnosis. Mould thrives in dark, damp environments, and bad smells often originate from trapped moisture, decaying organic matter (like food debris or spilled drinks), or a compromised air conditioning system. Common culprits include leaks from windows or sunroof seals, water trapped under carpets from spilled liquids or tracked-in rain, and condensation build-up. We conduct a thorough inspection, checking under seats, in the boot, door seals, and even the ventilation system for signs of moisture or microbial growth. A systematic approach is vital to pinpointing the origin of the problem, as simply masking the smell with air fresheners will only provide a temporary reprieve. Understanding the source allows us to address the underlying issue, preventing recurrence and ensuring a truly clean outcome. Sometimes, issues can be traced back to blocked drainage points in the car’s bodywork, which we are equipped to investigate.

Our Targeted Treatment for a Fresh, Healthy Cabin

Once the source of mould and odours is identified, a targeted treatment plan is implemented. For mould, we utilise professional-grade anti-fungal solutions and steam cleaning to safely and effectively eliminate spores and visible growth without damaging surfaces. Steam is particularly effective as it sanitises at high temperatures. For odours, we go beyond air fresheners. Our process may involve deep cleaning fabrics and carpets to remove the source of the smell, followed by the use of specialised odour neutralisers that break down odour molecules rather than just covering them up. Ozone treatments can also be employed for persistent, deeply embedded smells, as ozone gas can penetrate fabrics and air systems to eliminate stubborn odours. This comprehensive approach ensures that not only is the smell gone, but the air quality within your vehicle is significantly improved , creating a more pleasant and healthy driving environment. Frequently Asked Questions About Paint Correction London

1. What is paint correction?

Paint correction is a process where imperfections such as swirl marks, light scratches, oxidation, and other contaminants are removed from your car’s paint using specialized machines and abrasive polishing compounds. The goal is to restore the paint’s shine and smoothness without needing a full respray.

2. Does paint correction remove scratches?

Paint correction can remove light scratches and swirl marks that are only on the surface of the paint. However, it cannot remove deep scratches or gouges that go beyond the clear coat.

3. How long does paint correction last?

The results of paint correction can last anywhere from several months to a few years, depending on the level of protection you apply afterward, such as ceramic coatings or waxes, and how well you maintain your car.

4. What is the difference between paint correction and respraying?

Paint correction involves polishing and removing imperfections on the existing paint, while a respray involves completely applying new layers of paint to the car. Paint correction is ideal for minor surface imperfections, whereas a respray is needed for extensive damage like deep scratches, peeling paint, or severe fading.

5. Can paint correction fix faded paint?

Paint correction can help bring back some vibrancy to faded paint, especially if the dullness is caused by oxidation. However, if the paint is severely faded, a respray may be necessary to restore the original color.

6. How long does a paint correction service take?

The duration of paint correction depends on the condition of the paint and the size of the car, but typically, it can take anywhere from a few hours to a full day.

7. What should I do after paint correction?

After paint correction, it’s recommended to protect your car’s newly restored finish with a layer of wax, a paint sealant, or ceramic coating. This will help maintain the gloss and protect the paint from further damage.

8. Is paint correction worth the cost?

Yes, paint correction is a cost-effective way to restore the appearance of your car if it has surface imperfections. It’s generally much cheaper than a full respray and can give your car a fresh, glossy finish.

9. Can paint correction be done on any type of car?

Yes, paint correction can be performed on any type of car, regardless of make or model. However, certain colors, especially darker ones, may show imperfections more clearly, making paint correction particularly beneficial for them.

10. How do I know if my car needs paint correction or a full respray?

If your car has light surface imperfections like swirl marks or oxidation, paint correction is usually the right choice. However, if you have deep scratches, peeling paint, or severely faded color, a full respray may be necessary. A professional technician, like those at Ecoverde Valeting , can help assess your car’s needs.

FAQs

Frequently asked questions

What’s the difference between car paint correction and protection?
A: Correction removes defects (swirls, scratches), while protection (wax, sealant, or ceramic) locks in the finish.
Will it remove deep scratches?
A: It removes light to moderate scratches. Deeper ones may need paint respraying.
How long does protection last?
A: Wax lasts 6– 8 weeks , sealant 6–12 months, and ceramic coating up to 5 years.
Do you recommend ceramic coating after correction?
A: Yes — it’s the best way to preserve the freshly corrected finish.

Home/Valeting Service/Soft-Top Cleaning & Proofing
Soft-Top Cleaning & Proofing · West London

Soft-Top Decontamination, Deep Clean & Proofing

If your convertible roof looks dull, patchy, or has green mould creeping in, it needs more than a quick wipe-down. We fully decontaminate the fabric with a deep extraction clean to lift out ingrained dirt, algae and mould, then apply a premium re-proofing treatment to protect it against rain, UV and future staining. Serving convertible owners across Brentford, Ladbroke Grove and the rest of West London, all with eco-friendly, biodegradable products.

From £189 · free tailored quote
Call 07495 400369

What’s Included

  • Pre-treatment inspection to check fabric type and condition
  • Full decontamination to remove mould, algae and ingrained grime
  • Deep extraction clean using low-water, eco-friendly techniques
  • Gentle hand-agitation with soft-top-safe brushes, never harsh scrubbing
  • Careful clean of seams and stitching, where dirt builds up most
  • Premium water-repellent proofing treatment applied
  • UV protection to guard against fading
  • Finish check and drying to prevent water marks

Time: around 2 hours, depending on roof size and condition. Lasts: proofing typically protects for up to 12 months, depending on weather exposure.

Know Your Roof

Fabric and vinyl are not the same job

The first thing we establish is what your roof is actually made of, because the products for one will do nothing useful on the other.

Roof typeTypically found onWhat it needs
MohairPorsche, Aston Martin, higher-spec convertiblesA woven wool blend. Cleaned gently and reproofed with a fabric-specific product.
Double duck and canvasMost mainstream convertiblesHard-wearing woven fabric. Takes cleaning well and holds a proofer for longer.
VinylOlder cars, some roadstersA solid plastic surface, not woven. A fabric proofer cannot soak in, so it needs a dedicated vinyl cleaner and protectant instead.

Putting fabric proofer on a vinyl roof simply leaves a residue. Putting a vinyl dressing on a fabric roof clogs the weave and stops it breathing. It is worth getting right.

The Process

How we clean and reproof a soft top

  1. 1
    Dry brush first

    Loose grit is removed before any water goes near the roof. Wet grit dragged across fabric is abrasive.

  2. 2
    Mask the surrounding paint and glass

    Fabric cleaners are strong and will mark paint and rubber if left on them.

  3. 3
    Clean with a soft brush, by hand

    A dedicated fabric cleaner worked into the weave in sections. No pressure washer at any point.

  4. 4
    Extract, rather than rinse

    A deep extraction clean pulls the cleaner and the lifted dirt back out of the fabric together. It uses far less water than rinsing and avoids the tide marks rinsing can leave.

  5. 5
    Dry completely

    This is the step most often rushed. A proofer applied to a damp roof will not bond and the protection fails within weeks.

  6. 6
    Apply the proofer evenly, usually two coats

    Built up in thin layers rather than one heavy one, then left to cure before the roof is folded.

The whole job usually takes around 2 hours. It does need dry weather, so we book soft tops around the forecast rather than squeezing them into a wet afternoon.

Green Marks

Mould and algae on a convertible roof

In the UK this is the most common soft top complaint we get, and parking under trees or beside a damp wall makes it near enough inevitable.

  • Green or black spotting is algae and mould growing in the weave, not dirt sitting on top of it.
  • It has to be treated, not just washed. Scrubbing lifts the surface growth and leaves the spores, which come back within weeks.
  • We treat the growth, clean the fabric, then reproof, because a roof that has gone green has almost always lost its water repellency.
  • An honest expectation: on an older roof that has been green for a long time, staining can lighten dramatically rather than vanish. We will tell you which to expect once we have seen it.
Damage

What ruins a soft top

  • Automatic car washes. The single worst thing for a fabric roof. Spinning brushes abrade the weave and can catch stitching and rear window seams.
  • Pressure washers. They force water through the fabric into the cabin and will lift stitching and seam sealant.
  • Silicone and vinyl dressings on fabric. They block the weave, stop it breathing and leave a patchy shine that is difficult to remove.
  • Folding it away wet. The fastest route to mould and to permanent creasing.
  • Household detergent. It strips whatever proofing is left and leaves the roof soaking up water instead of shedding it.
The Window

Plastic rear windows and how often to book

Many convertibles have a flexible plastic rear window rather than glass. It scratches easily, yellows with age and must never be cleaned with ordinary glass cleaner, which clouds it permanently. We clean it with a dedicated plastic polish that can also reduce light hazing.

As for timing, a clean and reproof every six to twelve months suits most cars. The simplest test is water: if rain no longer beads and rolls off but soaks in and darkens the fabric, the proofing has gone and the roof is due. Leaving it past that point is when leaks and mould start.

FAQs

Frequently asked questions

How long does the soft top cleaning and proofing process take?
It usually takes around 2 hours, depending on the size of the roof and how much cleaning is required. Heavily soiled or badly mould-affected roofs can take longer, and we will tell you that before starting.
What does the proofing treatment do?
The proofing solution restores your roof’s water-repellent barrier , protecting it from UV rays, rain, and dirt. It also helps prevent fading and future mould growth.
Can you remove mould, mildew, and green algae?
Usually, yes. We use gentle, eco-friendly cleaners and soft brushes to lift mould, mildew and algae out of the weave without damaging the fabric or stitching. It needs treating rather than only washing, because scrubbing alone leaves the spores behind and the growth returns. On an older roof that has been green for a long time, staining can lighten considerably rather than disappear completely, and we will tell you which to expect first.
How long does the protection last?
Our premium proofing treatment typically lasts up to 12 months, depending on weather exposure and maintenance. A car kept in a garage holds its proofing far longer than one parked on-street under trees, and reproofing before it has fully worn off is easier than reviving a roof that has been soaking up water for a season.
How often should a soft top be cleaned and reproofed?
Every six to twelve months suits most convertibles in the UK. The simplest test is to watch what rain does. If water beads and rolls off, the proofing is still working. If it soaks in and darkens the fabric, the roof is due. Cars parked outside or under trees need it at the shorter end.
Is it safe to take a convertible through an automatic car wash?
No. It is the fastest way to damage a fabric roof. The spinning brushes abrade the weave, strip whatever proofing is on it and can catch stitching or the seam around the rear window. Hand washing is the only safe option for a soft top.
Do you clean vinyl roofs as well as fabric ones?
Yes, but as a different job with different products. Vinyl is a solid surface rather than a woven one, so a fabric proofer cannot soak in and simply sits on top as a residue. Vinyl gets a dedicated cleaner and a protectant suited to plastic instead.
Can you restore a faded or discoloured soft top?
Cleaning and reproofing brings back a great deal, and a roof that has gone grey with ingrained dirt often comes back much darker than the owner expects. Genuine UV fading is different, because the colour has gone from the fibres themselves. That needs a fabric re-colouring product rather than cleaning, and we will be straightforward about which yours needs.
How long does the roof take to dry?
Not long, because we extract rather than rinse. Extraction draws the water and the cleaner back out of the fabric together, so the roof dries far faster than one hosed down and left to air-dry. It still has to be properly dry before the proofer goes on, since a proofer applied to a damp roof will not bond, and we check that before applying it.
Can you clean the plastic rear window?
Yes. Flexible plastic rear windows scratch easily and yellow with age, and ordinary glass cleaner will cloud them permanently. We use a dedicated plastic polish which cleans it safely and can reduce light hazing, though deep scratches and long-term yellowing cannot be polished out.
Will this work if my roof hasn't been cleaned in a long time?
In most cases, yes. For heavily soiled or badly mould-affected roofs we may recommend additional treatment time. We will always assess your car first and give you a clear price before starting.

Questions & Answers

Frequently asked questions

What is a full car valet?
A full car valet is a complete inside-and-out clean designed to make your car look, feel, and smell like new. At Ecoverde Valeting, our full valet includes a professional exterior wash, wheel and tyre clean, hand polish, and wax protection. Inside, we carry out a deep vacuum, dashboard and trim clean, glass polish, and door frame detailing.
Is a full car valet worth the money?
Yes. A full valet is worth paying for if your car hasn't been cleaned for months, you're preparing for resale or lease return, you want better hygiene and interior freshness, or you drive a prestige or luxury vehicle. It also helps protect paintwork and interior materials, saving money long term.
How much does a full valet cost in the UK?
Across the UK, full valet prices range from £89 to £189. In London, expect prices toward the higher end due to labour costs, congestion, and premium service standards.
How much should I pay for a full valet in London?
In London, most people should expect to pay £89–£189 for a professional full car valet. Our own mobile valeting in Ladbroke Grove starts from £109 for a mini valet and £189 for a full valet. Prices depend on vehicle size, condition, and whether the service is mobile. In West London areas like Brentford (TW8) and Ladbroke Grove (W10), premium mobile valeting costs slightly more due to travel, insurance, and on-site equipment.
How long does a full car valet take?
A proper full car valet usually takes 2 to 4 hours, depending on condition and vehicle size. Rushed valets under 1 hour rarely deliver thorough results.
What does a full valet include?
A full valet involves a top-to-bottom clean of the vehicle using professional tools and products. Unlike a car wash, it focuses on detail, hygiene, and long-lasting results, especially important for family cars, lease returns, and luxury vehicles in London.
What happens if it rains?
At Ecoverde Valeting, we use professional canopies and specialised equipment that allow us to continue most valets even in light rain. However, if conditions are severe, we'll contact you in advance to reschedule for the next available slot that suits you.
How much does car detailing cost?
A full car detail in the UK costs £250–£600+, depending on paint condition, interior wear, vehicle type, and protection options. Ecoverde detailing packages in Ladbroke Grove run from £95 to £399 depending on the service booked. Detailing is ideal for enthusiasts, prestige cars, and long-term vehicle care.
What payment methods do you accept?
At Ecoverde Valeting, your payment security is our priority. We use Stripe, one of the world’s most trusted payment platforms, to process all transactions safely and efficiently. You can pay using Visa, Mastercard, or American Express, and every payment is fully encrypted for peace of mind. Once your valet is complete, you’ll instantly receive an email confirmation and receipt with no hidden charges — just a smooth and secure checkout experience.
Do I need to provide water or electricity?
No, you don’t. At Ecoverde Valeting, all our vans are fully self-contained with their own water supply, power source, and professional equipment. We can carry out a complete valet anywhere — at your home, office, or even a parking lot — without needing access to your utilities.
Do I need to provide parking?
Our team is completely mobile and experienced in working in all types of spaces, from residential driveways to office car parks and street parking. We simply need safe access to your vehicle. If parking restrictions apply in your area, let us know when booking and we’ll plan accordingly to ensure a smooth, hassle-free service.
Do I need to be present?
Not necessarily. Many of our customers book while they’re at work or home. As long as we have access to your vehicle and the keys (if interior cleaning is included), our team can complete the valet independently. Once the job is done, we’ll update you with photos or a quick message so you know your car is spotless and ready to go.
Can I cancel or reschedule my booking?
Yes, of course. If you need to adjust your booking, just let us know at least 24 hours in advance, and we’ll happily move your appointment or cancel it without any charge. If something comes up on the day, we’ll do our best to accommodate a new time that works for you. Our goal is to keep things flexible, fair, and hassle-free for every customer.
Can I book extras or multiple cars?
Absolutely. We regularly handle bookings for families, businesses, and car enthusiasts who want more than one vehicle cleaned. You can also add extras such as engine bay cleaning, pet hair removal, odour treatment, or paint protection to any valet package.
Can I request a receipt and/or VAT invoice?
Yes, you can. Every customer receives an automated email receipt after payment, and a VAT invoice can be issued upon request. Just let our team know during or after booking and we’ll send it directly to your email.

Why London Drivers Need Mobile Car Valeting

Life in London moves fast. Between busy commutes, limited parking, and unpredictable weather, keeping your car clean often slips down the priority list. Traditional car washes require time, travel, and waiting around — something most Londoners simply don’t have.

At Ecoverde, we specialize in mobile car valeting and detailing services across London, bringing professional cleaning directly to your doorstep. Whether at home or your office, our eco-friendly methods restore your car to showroom condition without wasting water or using harmful chemicals.

If you’ve been considering upgrading your car care routine, here are the top seven benefits of choosing mobile car valeting in London.

 

1. Save Precious Time in a Busy City

Londoners spend an average of 74 hours per year stuck in traffic — ranking among the highest congestion times in Europe. The last thing you want is to add more driving just to visit a car wash.

With mobile valeting, we come to you. No queues, no travel, no wasted weekends. While you’re working, relaxing at home, or even shopping, your car is cleaned and detailed right where it’s parked.

👉 Time saved = more freedom to enjoy London life.

2. Convenience at Your Doorstep

Mobile valeting is about flexibility. Whether you live in Kensington, Canary Wharf, Croydon, or Hackney, our fully equipped team brings everything required to clean your car inside and out.

  • No need to provide water or electricity.

  • Appointments that fit around your schedule.

  • Services available in residential and commercial areas.

For busy professionals and families, the convenience factor is unbeatable.

3. Eco-Friendly Cleaning That Protects the Planet

Traditional car washes can use 150–200 litres of water per wash, with harsh chemicals often running into drains.

At Ecoverde, our approach is different:

  • Water-saving techniques, using low-water methods.

  • Biodegradable products safe for kids, pets, and the environment.

  • Microfibre technology for scratch-free finishes.

Choosing eco-friendly mobile valeting means you’re not only protecting your car — you’re also contributing to a cleaner, greener London.

4. Professional Results Beyond a Standard Wash

Mobile valeting isn’t just about a quick rinse. It’s a comprehensive detailing process designed to restore and protect your vehicle:

  • Exterior Care: Hand washing, waxing, and paint correction.

  • Interior Detailing: Deep cleaning carpets, seats, and dashboards.

  • Special Treatments: Ceramic coating, odour removal, and engine bay cleaning.

With attention to every detail, your car doesn’t just look clean — it feels brand new.

5. Protect Your Investment

Cars in London face unique challenges:

  • Air pollution causes paint and glass damage.

  • Tree sap and bird droppings in residential streets.

  • Winter road salt leading to corrosion.

Regular detailing adds a protective layer that shields your car from these hazards. For many clients, this means maintaining higher resale value and reducing long-term repair costs.

6. Tailored Packages for Every Driver

Every London driver is different — from the daily commuter to the weekend adventurer. That’s why our mobile valeting packages are tailored to suit your needs:

  • Mini Valet: Quick refresh for busy schedules.

  • Full Valet: Complete deep clean inside and out.

  • Detailing Packages: Paint correction, ceramic protection, and more.

We work with you to find the best option for your lifestyle and budget.

7. Trusted Service with Local Expertise

At Ecoverde, we’ve worked on vehicles across London boroughs — from compact city cars to luxury SUVs. Our experience in London means we understand the specific challenges local drivers face.

Here’s what one client had to say:

“I booked Ecoverde for a full valet at my office in Canary Wharf. Not only did they save me hours, but my car looked like it had just rolled out of the showroom. The eco-friendly products were a huge bonus too!”
— James H., London
